text:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up — SwissBank Inc wants a POC but requires that processing and storage stay in Switzerland (CH-only). Can we guarantee that for a POC? They also asked for sub-processor names and a rough pricing delta. Timeline: 2 weeks.

sanjay_engineering: Short answer: Hosted API can't guarantee CH physical locality today. We have 2 pragmatic paths: Dedicated with tenant-pin + region affinity (best-effort toward CH edge) or Private/on-prem deployed into CH via partner. We've done one onboarding with HelveticCloud for a finance customer. BYOK/HSM is usually a hard requirement for them.

sanjay_engineering: Example routing policy (tenant-level) we can propose for the POC:
```json
{"routing_policy":"tenant_pin","preferred_region":"ch-central","strict_residency":true,"failover":"no_fallback"}
```

maria_sales: Nice — ballpark, what does Dedicated in CH cost vs our normal eu-central price? Need to tell procurement.

sanjay_engineering: Ballpark numbers (preliminary): +20-40% infra premium for CH-dedicated (smaller regional pools), +30% on top if BYOK/HSM required (one-time integration + monthly). Private/on-prem with a partner (HelveticCloud) for a small POC: estimate ~USD 15k-25k/month depending on instance shape and KMS/HSM. I can get exact with ops in 48h.

claire_legal: They asked for sub-processor list, DPA language (data transfer basis), and certifications. Also flagged Schrems II concerns and whether control-plane metadata leaves CH.

noah_sre: Control-plane: for Hosted/Dedicated our control-plane metadata is currently in EU regions; we can minimise telemetry for the POC. For Private with HelveticCloud the control plane can be customer-hosted in their VPC so nothing leaves CH. Subprocessors we'd use for CH deployment: HelveticCloud (hosting partner), CloudNetCH (networking), Redwood-support (ops). Will prepare a redacted subprocessor list and attestations.

ops_bot: ticket created #POC-CH-789 — assignees @sanjay_engineering @noah_sre. Target: quote + subproc list in 48h :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll share the rough delta and confirm whether they require BYOK/HSM. Please attach the DPA snippet and subproc link when ready.

sanjay_engineering: Subproc list (preview): https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors/ch — sample DPA snippet: `Data processing and storage for the tenant will be located in Switzerland. Control-plane telemetry will be minimised; customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) required if requested.` I'll DM the full legal export and a formal quote once ops confirms sizing.

maria_sales: Thanks — keeping the customer in the loop now. Will follow up if they push for immediate Private deploy. :thumbsup:
